description: Per-trial measurement counts from the three IonQ Aria-1 QPU executions used for the hardware column of the three-qubit results table. Each trial ran the observational circuit and the two post-surgery interventional circuits (do(T=1), do(T=0)) with 1,024 requested shots per circuit.

provenance.source_file: simpson_paradox_ionq_aria-1_qpu_20250815_050134.json (original run record, kept with the author)

trials_excluded.reason: The run log records an IonQ QuotaExhaustedError after trial 2; trials 3 and 4 were produced by the script's automatic fallback to a local Qiskit Aer simulator and are not hardware data. The original file's experiment_info (n_trials=5, simulator=false) reflects the requested configuration, not the per-trial backend, which the run script did not record.

provenance.counts_origin: For QPU jobs qiskit-ionq reconstructs counts as round(p * shots) from the per-outcome probabilities returned by the IonQ API (qiskit_ionq.ionq_job._build_counts). Independent rounding per outcome makes the recorded total differ from the requested 1,024 by up to a few shots; eight of the nine QPU circuit runs below total 1,025. Simulator jobs are sampled exactly and total 1,024, which independently corroborates the exclusion above.
provenance.bit_order: Qiskit little-endian; string 'OTG' with q0=G (gender), q1=T (treatment), q2=O (outcome). The trailing ' 000' are unused classical bits.
